description: AI Cycle Monitor: the AI Capex Pulse, a monthly gauge of the AI investment cycle on the 50 line (50 = average growth since 2012, 10 points = 1 standard deviation) built from chips, chipmaking equipment and server output/trade/revenue (Fed industrial production, Census orders, UN Comtrade, TSMC and Taiwan server makers' filings) and data-centre build-out (Census data-centre construction, electricity in data-centre states, electrical equipment orders, hyperscaler capex from SEC filings). Returns the headline with history, the two pillars, every component (latest y/y growth and signal), economy readings (us, tw, kr, jp, nl, my), adoption indicators (US firms using AI, AI job postings by country, AI search interest, AI bot traffic), AI equity baskets vs world equities, and the correlation with later US IT investment. Give economy for one economy's reading and components.

economy.description: Economy code (us, tw, kr, jp, nl, my); omit for the world view

months.description: Months of headline history to return (latest last)

name: get_ai_cycle
